title: Tanzanian Rice with Beans
community: The affordable everyday combination enjoyed nationwide
author: Mama Salima
desc: Wali wa Maharage — rice served alongside a thick, spiced bean stew. Tanzania's most complete affordable meal — the combination of rice and beans provides all essential amino acids in a single plate. Eaten daily by millions across the country.
longDesc: Wali wa Maharage is Tanzania's most democratic meal — affordable, nutritious, filling, and universally beloved. The rice is always plain; the beans are cooked in a tomato-onion sauce until thick and creamy. Together they form a nutritionally complete meal that has sustained Tanzania for generations.
ingredients: 400g dried kidney or red beans — soaked overnight
steps: Cook soaked beans in fresh water for 60—75 minutes until tender. Reserve liquid.
Cook onions until golden. Add garlic, tomatoes, and curry powder. Cook 8 minutes.
Add beans and reserved liquid. Simmer 15 minutes until thick.
Serve rice with bean stew alongside.
chefTips: The bean cooking liquid adds flavour — use it in the stew.
The stew should coat the back of a spoon.
cookingScience: See TZA008 for the protein complementarity science of rice and beans.
sustainabilityTips: Beans are nitrogen-fixing — the most environmentally responsible protein source.
culturalNote: Wali wa Maharage is Tanzania's most complete everyday meal — the combination that has fed the country's working people for generations. It appears at every mama lishe and is the default lunch for much of urban Tanzania.
